This page is a list of all '''baits''' available in {{TWMS}}. In version 1.1 only a basic lure was available, which attracted random [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|monsters]] to [[nemeton|nemeta]]. This item could not be crafted, but was available for purchase or received as a reward for completing [[The Witcher Monster Slayer contracts|contracts]] or leveling up.
